metadata.description:
Pandey Ravindar Nath Rai — a renowned lawyer and respected expert on tribal laws in Jharkhand — delivers an insightful lecture on the occasion of 117 years of the Chotanagpur Tenancy (CNT) Act. Known for his deep understanding of the customary laws, traditions, and history of Adivasi movements, Pandey Rai traces how the CNT Act became a cornerstone in protecting tribal land rights and identity in Jharkhand.
In this thought-provoking session, he explains the spirit behind the Act, the struggles that led to its formation, and the continuing challenges faced by tribal communities in safeguarding their constitutional and customary rights.
Watch this important conversation to understand how the CNT Act continues to shape the discourse on Adivasi land, culture, and self-determination even after more than a century.
🎥 Presented by: मैं भी भारत (Main Bhi Bharat)
📍 Event: 117 Years of CNT Act Celebration, Ranchi
👤 Speaker: Pandey Ravindar Nath Rai, Senior Advocate and Expert on Tribal Laws
